title: With Tua Tagovailoa and Penix sidelined, undrafted rookie QB getting first-team reps with Falcons

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: With Tua Tagovailoa and Penix sidelined, undrafted rookie QB getting first-team reps with Falcons
sources.description: The Falcons were short of quarterback arms Thursday, thrusting undrafted free agent Jack Strand in with the first-team offense. Does he have a shot to make it?
